functions.does: Pushed along, the rear wheels run the V8 engine behind the cab: the rear differential's 28 tooth crown drives a 12 tooth bevel gear on a shaft running forward, two 20 tooth bevel gears turn the drive up and forward into the crankshaft, and the eight pistons pump up and down in their two banks.
functions.source: book 1: engine steps 1-11 (pages 15-19), steps 27-31 (engine fitted, the gears, step 31 on page 27 draws the pistons moving), rear axle steps 1-13 (differential, pages 22-25), steps 30-33 (pages 26-29)

functions.does: The rear differential lets the two rear wheels turn at different speeds; with the truck lifted, turning one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way.

The gear on top of the cab's roof steers the front wheels (hand of god steering): a long vertical shaft runs down behind the seat, two knob wheels turn the drive forward, and a 12 tooth gear drives the steering rack, whose links turn both front wheels.
functions.source: book 1: steps 3-13 (front axle, rack and links, pages 3-7), steps 40-46 (the vertical shaft, its knob wheels and the gear on top, pages 37-45; the arrow on step 42); book 2 step 69 onward (the cab built round it)

functions.does: The front wheels roll freely, and the four wheels together let the truck be pushed along.
The steering wheel in the cab turns freely; it isn't linked to the steering.
functions.source: book 2: grille steps 1-8 (pages 15-18); inferred: from the model, nothing links it to the steering
